text:
carmen: FYI - Helix wants 50 seats. Procurement requesting 6mo pilot then auto-convert. Need acceptance path by EOD to secure SE slot next week.
leo: What discount are they asking?
carmen: ~20% for pilot, full price on convert. Finance cautious.
tara: Legal: CFO OOO. Can delegated signer sign?
contracts-bot: Delegation allowed if PO names delegate or we get a one-page Delegation Addendum. Recommend Docusign.
procurement: Drafting PO template with delegated-signer field, ETA 1.5h.
leo: Customer prefers 50% upfront for pilot; finance prefers full. Recommend 50% + card-on-file.
carmen: I'll send two options: A) 6mo -20% with 50% upfront + Delegation Addendum; B) annual at list with full upfront. Hold SE tentatively.
tara: I'll prep Delegation Addendum and fast-track review.
procurement: PO sent to carmen@helix.com.
carmen: Buyer replied: "Option A preferred, can we accept PO scan while CFO returns?"
contracts-bot: Acceptable as interim if named delegate present; require addendum executed within 3 business days.
leo: pinging @finance for final approval on 50% concession.
carmen: Thanks team - I'll update once signed. :thumbsup:
